Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Y ticks: chart/axis/tick-count per device (Mobile 4, Tablet 5, Web 6), nice numbers (0, 25, 50…).
Compact units: 4,8 mln, 12 ming; unit once in the subtitle.
X: first and last labels are always visible; never rotate labels — shorten or skip instead.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.

Purpose
Tick labels for the value (Y) and category / time (X) axes.

Y ticks ← nice(scale.domain, tick-count) · X ticks ← categories / time interval
Interaction
None.
Accessibility
Axis titles exposed via aria-label on the chart; ticks are decorative (aria-hidden) when a table view exists.
